about.paragraph_one: SOLHER was born from a simple observation: the world moves too fast, but true beauty is patient. Our founder dreamed of a bag that didn't just last a season, but grew more beautiful with every passing year—much like the women who carry them.
about.paragraph_two: Every SOLHER piece begins with the touch of the hand. We source the highest grade of cow leather, chosen for its unique grain and supple strength. It is a material that breathes, lives, and tells a story. Our artisans treat every hide with the respect it deserves, ensuring that when you hold a SOLHER bag, you are holding years of tradition and a promise of tomorrow.
about.paragraph_three: We don't believe in trends. We believe in the quiet confidence of a classic silhouette. We believe that a woman’s bag is a keeper of her secrets, her dreams, and her daily triumphs. This is our gift to you: a piece of timeless luxury that stays by your side, forever.
about.cta_1: We make things that work better and last longer.

customer_care.description: We are here to help you discover the best natural solutions for your health and well-being.
customer_care.our_cs: Our customer service is available every day:

items.question: What is the return policy?
items.answer: Our goal is for every customer to be totally satisfied with their purchase. If this isn't the case, let us know and we'll do our best to work with you to make it right.

items.question: Are any purchases final sale?
items.answer: We are unable to accept returns on certain items. These will be carefully marked before purchase.

items.question: When will I get my order?
items.answer: We will work quickly to ship your order as soon as possible. Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email with further information. Delivery times vary depending on your location.

items.question: Where are your products manufactured?
items.answer: Our products are manufactured both locally and globally. We carefully select our manufacturing partners to ensure our products are high quality and a fair value.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Shipping is calculated based on your location and the items in your order. You will always know the shipping price before you purchase.

terms.subtitle: Solher Indonesia
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Solher. By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

sections.heading: 1. Account & Membership
sections.content: When you create an account with us, you must provide information that is accurate and complete. New registered users may be eligible for welcome bonuses, such as Loyalty Points. Accumulated points can be used as discounts during checkout, subject to maximum deduction limits.

sections.heading: 2. Products & Pricing
sections.content: We have made every effort to display the colors and images of our products accurately. We cannot guarantee that your computer monitor's display of any color will be accurate. All prices are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products at any time.

sections.heading: 3. Order Limitation & Stock
sections.content: We reserve the right to refuse any order you place with us. In the event of a stock discrepancy or a race condition during high-traffic sales, our system strictly allocates stock on a first-come, first-served basis. If your payment is processed but the item is out of stock, an automatic refund will be issued.

sections.heading: 4. Payment Security
sections.content: All online transactions are securely processed through our authorized payment gateway. We do not store your credit card details directly on our servers.

privacy_policy.cta_1: Solher ('we', 'our', or 'us') respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website.
privacy_policy.first_desc: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you, including:
privacy_policy.data_contact: Billing address, delivery address, email address, and telephone numbers.
privacy_policy.data_financial: Payment details processed securely by our third-party gateway.
privacy_policy.data_transaction: Details about payments to and from you and other details of products you have purchased from us.
privacy_policy.second_desc: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
privacy_policy.delivery_process: To process and deliver your order, including managing payments and calculating shipping rates.
privacy_policy.manage_relationship: To manage our relationship with you, including notifying you about changes to our terms or privacy policy.
privacy_policy.marketing_communication: To send marketing communications, if you have opted in to our newsletter.
privacy_policy.third_desc: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorized way. Access to your personal data is limited to those employees, agents, and contractors who have a business need to know.

sections.heading: 1. Processing Time
sections.content: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days (excluding weekends and national holidays) after receiving your order confirmation email. You will receive another notification when your order has shipped.

sections.heading: 2. Shipping Rates & Delivery Estimates
sections.content: We partner with multiple trusted logistics providers to offer you the best rates and delivery times. Shipping charges for your order will be calculated and displayed at checkout based on the volumetric weight of the items and your destination address.

list.label: Instant/Same Day
list.desc: Delivery on the same day if ordered before 14:00 WIB.

list.label: Regular
list.desc: Typically 2-5 business days depending on your location.

sections.heading: 3. Order Tracking
sections.content: Once your order is dispatched, you can track its real-time status directly from your "Orders" page in your account dashboard. Please allow up to 24 hours for the tracking portal to update.

sections.heading: 4. In-Store Pickup
sections.content: You can skip the shipping fees with free local pickup at our physical booth locations or partnered stores (e.g., Kecilung Kitchen & Resto) during special events. After placing your order and selecting local pickup at checkout, your order will be prepared and ready for pick up within 1 business day.

sections.heading: 1. Automatic Refunds (Cancellations)
paragraphs: If your order is cancelled before it is processed by our logistics partner, or if the logistics provider rejects the pickup, our system will automatically initiate a full refund to your original payment method. Any Loyalty Points used will also be instantly restored to your account.

sections.heading: 2. Manual Refund Requests
paragraphs: We accept return and refund requests within 3 days of the delivery date. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused, in the same condition that you received it, and in its original packaging (including the dust bag and tags).
You can submit a refund request directly through your "Orders" page. A mandatory unboxing video or clear photos of the product defect must be uploaded as proof.

sections.heading: 3. Processing Your Refund
paragraphs: Once your return is received and inspected by our team, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. If approved, the refund will be processed immediately. Please note that it may take some time for your bank or credit card company to officially post the refund.

sections.heading: 4. Non-Refundable Items
paragraphs: Certain types of items cannot be returned, including sale items, custom-designed products, or items damaged due to improper care. Shipping costs are non-refundable.
